title: Word Transformation Ladder
statement: Return the number of words in the shortest sequence from `begin` to `end`, changing one letter at a time and using only listed intermediate words. Return 0 if impossible.
constraints: All words have equal lowercase length.
hints: Treat words as graph nodes and one-letter changes as edges.
Breadth-first search finds the fewest transformations.
Generate neighbors by replacing each position with every lowercase letter.
Remove discovered words immediately so each is enqueued once.
editorial: Breadth-first search from begin explores transformation counts in order. Generated valid neighbors are removed from the remaining set when queued.

tests.explanation: A shortest sequence is hit → hot → dot → dog → cog, containing five words.
Because 'cog' is unavailable, no valid transformation can finish.
